description: fluent-forward/logs: timestamp from common keys, host normalization, records otherwise untouched

script.if: ctx['time'] != null || ctx['timestamp'] != null || ctx['ts'] != null
script.source: String[] keys = new String[]{'time','timestamp','ts'}; for (int i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) { def v = ctx[keys[i]]; if (v == null) { continue; } if (v instanceof Number) { double d = v.doubleValue(); ctx._ts_ms = (long)(d >= 1.0E11 ? d : d * 1000.0); } else { String s = v.toString().trim(); try { double d = Double.parseDouble(s); ctx._ts_ms = (long)(d >= 1.0E11 ? d : d * 1000.0); } catch (NumberFormatException e) { ctx._ts_iso = s; } } break; }

script.if: ctx.hostname instanceof String && (ctx.host == null || ctx.host.name == null)
script.source: if (ctx.host == null) { ctx.host = new HashMap(); } ctx.host.name = ctx.hostname; ctx.remove('hostname');
